hero.title: Madrasadaada oo dhan ka maamul hal meel
hero.subtitle: MMS wuxuu madrasadaha ka caawiyaa qaadashada xaadiriska, maamulka ardayda iyo ustaadyada, qabashada imtixaannada iyo la socodsiinta waalidka, adigoo isticmaalaya luqadda aad doorbiddo.

features.title: Wax kasta oo madrasad u baahan tahay
features.subtitle: Qalab fudud oo loogu talagalay maamulayaasha iyo ustaadyada, kuna shaqeeya si fiican taleefan kasta.

attendance.title: Xaadiriska maalinlaha ah
attendance.description: Ustaadyadu ilbiriqsiyo gudahood ayay ku calaamadeeyaan jooga, maqan ama daahay. Maamulayaashuna isla markiiba waxay arkaan xaaladda oo dhan.

students.title: Diiwaanka ardayda
students.description: Fasalka, sawirka iyo lambarrada waalidka arday kasta ku hay hal meel oo habaysan.

exams.title: Imtixaannada iyo natiijooyinka
exams.description: Samee imtixaanno, geli buundooyinka oo daabac warqado natiijo oo cad oo fasal kasta ah.

parents.title: La socodka waalidka
parents.description: Ardayda maqnaanshahoodu soo noqnoqdo si toos ah ayaa loo calaamadeeyaa, iyadoo lambarka waalidkood diyaar u yahay in la waco.

reports.title: Warbixinnada
reports.description: Jaantusyada isbeddelka xaadiriska, buundooyinka iyo tirada fasallada ayaa kaa caawinaya inaad dhibaatooyinka goor hore ogaato.

languages.title: Madrasado badan, luqado badan
languages.description: Madrasad kastaa waxay leedahay meel u gaar ah oo qarsoon, isticmaale kastaana wuxuu dooran karaa luqaddiisa.

footer.copyright: © {year} MMS — Nidaamka Maamulka Madrasadaha. Xuquuqda oo dhan way dhowran tahay.

errorPage.title: Cillad ayaa dhacday
errorPage.description: Cillad lama filaan ah ayaa dhacday. Fadlan isku day mar kale.

notFound.title: Bogga lama helin
notFound.description: Raali ahow, boggii aad raadinaysay ma jiro ama meel kale ayaa loo raray.
